related_claims.content: For obtaining competitive winning tickets in the large-model and large-dataset regime of natural-image classification, an iterative magnitude-pruning schedule with pruning fraction per iteration 0.2 (20% of remaining parameters) over up to 30 iterations combined with late resetting to parameters at a small early training iteration—resetting to the parameters after 1 epoch for Fashion-MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and after 3 epochs for ImageNet and Places365—produced effective winning tickets, with learning-rate annealing schedules and other hyperparameters matched per model family.

Winning-ticket initializations discovered by iterative magnitude pruning on ImageNet, Places365, and, to a lesser extent, CIFAR-100 produce sparse initializations that, when used to train a VGG19 or ResNet50 architecture on SVHN, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet, and Places365, frequently achieve test accuracies on the target tasks that are close to the accuracies obtained by winning tickets discovered directly on those target datasets.
